rules: Explicit scope wording outranks the UI selection.
A named individual target such as this card or this heading remains local even when the chat is opened at section scope.
All/every + semantic design primitive routes to a global design token when such a token exists.
Whole page affects the current page only; whole website/sitewide may affect site-level design settings.
Never broaden this/selected/only/just wording into page or site scope.
Ambiguous requests inherit the current UI scope and element context.
A site-wide token request should not iterate and mutate every Spark when a centralized token can represent the same intent.
